A '''shock glove''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armored]] glove that was coated with a webbed lacing. This webbing carried a charge that was powerful enough to damage organics or other objects that the glove came in contact with. One type of shock glove was the [[X-21 shock glove]] produced by [[Corellian Personal Defense/Legends|Corellian Personal Defense]], who also produced the [["Big Shock"]] shock webbing.
